findings.title: verify-question-bank cron never worked
findings.description: Signing headers in grounded-client.ts (x-internal-timestamp + x-internal-signature) are not validated by the Edge Function endpoint, causing 401 on every invocation. Platform's primary runtime integrity check for question bank answers has been a no-op since deployment.
findings.evidence: Static analysis of grounded-client.ts and Edge Function entry point

findings.title: question_bank answer key exposed to authenticated users
findings.description: RLS policy question_bank_authenticated_read USING(true) grants any authenticated user full SELECT access to correct_answer_index, correct_answer_text, explanation, solution_steps, and hint columns for all 12,826+ questions. Students can bypass quiz UI and query REST API directly for answer keys.
findings.evidence: Live query against production pg_policies + direct REST API test

findings.title: RAG retrieval regression
findings.description: recall@10 at 66.1% and faithfulness at ~40-47% against 95% bars. 3/5 mandated metrics (recall@3, correctness, abstention) not computed. Leading hypothesis: corpus-growth dilution (16k to 27k chunks).

findings.title: CI Gate not in required status checks
findings.description: CI Gate workflow runs on PRs but is not listed in GitHub main-protection required status checks. PRs can merge without passing tests.

findings.title: Single-person email-only alerting
findings.description: All alerts go to a single CEO email inbox. No redundant notification channel (Slack, PagerDuty, SMS). If email is down or inbox full, critical alerts are lost.

findings.title: webhook-dispatcher query param secret
findings.description: webhook-dispatcher accepts auth token as ?token= query parameter. Tokens in URLs are logged in server access logs, browser history, and CDN caches.

findings.title: streak-guardian duplicate records
findings.description: streak-guardian uses INSERT without idempotency key. Duplicate runs create duplicate streak records, inflating student streak counts.

findings.title: match_rag_chunks_ncert EXECUTE grant to authenticated
findings.description: match_rag_chunks_ncert RPC has EXECUTE granted to authenticated role. Exposes raw vector search to any logged-in user. All legitimate callers use service_role.

findings.title: Error message leaks in 3 catch blocks
findings.description: session-guard, teacher-dashboard, parent-portal catch blocks return raw err.message to client. Stack traces, DB error messages, and internal paths could leak.

findings.title: Default table privileges auto-grant to anon/authenticated
findings.description: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES auto-grants INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE to anon and authenticated on all new public tables.

findings.title: Default function privileges auto-grant to anon/authenticated
findings.description: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES auto-grants EXECUTE to anon and authenticated on all new public functions.

findings.title: institution_admin self-serve role creation unverified
findings.description: institution_admin can self-serve create users with same role. Unverified by product whether this is intended behavior.

findings.title: Permission check mismatch in 3 routes
findings.description: 3 routes (teacher-dashboard, parent-portal, assessment) run permission checks but don't enforce the result.

findings.title: compute_mrr_snapshot executable by anon
findings.description: Financial RPC compute_mrr_snapshot is executable by anon role. Should be admin-only.

findings.title: exam_papers etc. USING(true) policies
findings.description: exam_papers, assessment_templates, report_templates have USING(true) SELECT policies. Over-permissive for admin-only tables.

findings.title: Stale DESIGN_ONLY migration in migrations directory
findings.description: Migration 20260823154500 marked DESIGN_ONLY still in supabase/migrations/. Could be accidentally applied.

findings.title: Learning velocity clamps negative values
findings.description: calculateLearningVelocity clamps negative values to 0. Regression signals are suppressed, making mastery predictions falsely optimistic.

findings.title: Experiment evidence not persisted
findings.description: recordExperimentEvidence collects data but never persists to DB. Experiment outcomes lost on process exit.

findings.title: BKT hardcoded priors
findings.description: BKT model uses hardcoded priors (P(L0)=0.3, P(T)=0.09, P(G)=0.2, P(S)=0.1) rather than per-concept calibrated values.

findings.title: BKT/IRT model divergence risk
findings.description: BKT (SQL) and IRT (TypeScript) models can produce divergent mastery estimates without reconciliation.

findings.title: Foxy message query defense-in-depth gap
findings.description: Message retrieval query in Foxy chat does not include .eq('student_id', studentId). RLS provides primary protection but defense-in-depth is missing.

findings.title: Foxy error.tsx leaks raw errors
findings.description: Foxy error boundary leaks raw error messages to students instead of showing generic error.

findings.title: Single notification channel for all severity levels
findings.description: No escalation tiers. P0 incidents get same delivery as P3 informational alerts.

findings.title: No SLO/SLA dashboards
findings.description: No formal latency/availability targets tracked. Can't measure service quality commitments to schools.

findings.title: Edge auth sweep advisory only
findings.description: Edge auth sweep CI check runs advisory (non-blocking). Security findings don't fail the build.

findings.title: Migration lint not in required checks
findings.description: Lint migrations workflow runs but is not in required status checks. Destructive migrations can merge without lint approval.

findings.title: Staging deploy disabled
findings.description: Staging deploy workflow disabled. Staging Supabase project inaccessible. Migrations go directly to production.

verified_closures.title: TRUNCATE grants on all tables
verified_closures.evidence: Live query: 0/427 tables grant TRUNCATE to anon/authenticated

verified_closures.title: 7 views bypassing RLS
verified_closures.evidence: Independent behavioral probe confirmed SECURITY INVOKER conversion

verified_closures.title: Money table write access
verified_closures.evidence: Live query: 0 grants to anon/authenticated on payment tables
